{
  "id": "native:buffer",
  "name": "Buffer",
  "provider": "native",
  "group": "Vector geometry",
  "summary": "Computes a buffer area for all the features in an input layer, using a fixed or dynamic distance.",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "INPUT",
      "description": "Input layer",
      "type": "source",
      "optional": false,
      "default": null
    },
    {
      "name": "DISTANCE",
      "description": "Distance",
      "type": "distance",
      "optional": false,
      "default": 10,
      "minimum": -1.7976931348623157e+308,
      "maximum": 1.7976931348623157e+308
    },
    {
      "name": "SEGMENTS",
      "description": "Segments",
      "type": "number",
      "optional": false,
      "default": 5,
      "minimum": 1.0,
      "maximum": 1.7976931348623157e+308
    },
    {
      "name": "END_CAP_STYLE",
      "description": "End cap style",
      "type": "enum",
      "optional": false,
      "default": 0,
      "options": [
        "Round",
        "Flat",
        "Square"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "JOIN_STYLE",
      "description": "Join style",
      "type": "enum",
      "optional": false,
      "default": 0,
      "options": [
        "Round",
        "Miter",
        "Bevel"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "MITER_LIMIT",
      "description": "Miter limit",
      "type": "number",
      "optional": false,
      "default": 2,
      "minimum": 1.0,
      "maximum": 1.7976931348623157e+308
    },
    {
      "name": "DISSOLVE",
      "description": "Dissolve result",
      "type": "boolean",
      "optional": false,
      "default": false
    },
    {
      "name": "SEPARATE_DISJOINT",
      "description": "Keep disjoint results separate",
      "type": "boolean",
      "optional": false,
      "default": false
    },
    {
      "name": "OUTPUT",
      "description": "Buffered",
      "type": "sink",
      "optional": false,
      "default": null
    }
  ],
  "outputs": [
    {
      "name": "OUTPUT",
      "description": "Buffered",
      "type": "outputVector"
    }
  ]
}
